name: Lumia 1520 app development reference

guest.status: KVM Start screen, native portrait display, guest UI 250%, GTK 50% and single-contact touch observed. Device Portal initial authentication page reached; pairing and user app deployment untested. Audio PCM captured on earlier Ubuntu QEMU, not retested on the custom build.
guest.ui_scale_application: Applied manually in Windows settings to the current writable overlay; fresh SDK imports require configuration.
guest.logical_metrics_note: logical_dpi and effective_pixels are calculated from 250% scale, not measured using a guest app API.
guest.touch_validation: QMP and GTK Phone-tile taps, GTK keypad taps (80ms and 20ms), QMP and GTK drag verified after Confidence-on-lift fix.

limitations: This profile is not a QEMU Snapdragon 800 or Lumia board implementation.
ARM-only packages require an x86 rebuild for the SDK guest.
Camera, modem, sensors, GPU performance and physical-device behavior require separate validation.
Touch input supports one contact. Multi-touch and pinch gestures are not implemented.
configuration_note: Descriptive profile and validation record; the launcher does not automatically apply every field.
